skill.summary: Batch document OCR, classification, and extraction for up to 500 images. Flat $15.00 USDC via x402.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ntriq-x402-document-intel-batch:

- Batch OCR, classification, table extraction, and summarization for up to 500 document images per request
- Simple API endpoint with support for image URLs and analysis type selection
- Flat $15.00 USDC payment via x402 protocol (Base mainnet, gasless)
- 100% local processing on Mac Mini for data privacy
- Supports extraction, summarization, classification, and table analysis modes
